accepts.because: a fresh turn from the surface
the expectation set of a tool round
a round that ran out of iterations
a memory tool call the brain made

emits.because: the seam: the assembled context, for the caller's edge to carry the iteration bound and restore_ttl
a memory read this turn needs
the turn is finished (a capped round is told apart by hop.round_capped)
a closed session as one write batch
one finished turn, for whoever keeps episodes
a prune request for the window

description.purpose: Scope marker of the collector hive: bundles the assembly state machine and its state surface. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS — everything from outside is sent to the hive itself, never to a cell inside it, and the hive hands it on. What an agent's LLM sees is decided in here, in one place, instead of spread over a persona cell, a prep cell and a tool-loop collector.
description.use_when: One per agent brain. Instantiate per agent tree and wire the parent's edges TO THE HIVE PATH (`./collector`), not to anything below it — see meclaw-overview § Die Hive-Grenze. `params.ports` is empty and therefore sealed: a mutation that reaches inside is rejected with hive_port_boundary.
description.not_in_scope: No inference, no persona, no tool fan-out, no durable memory. And no knowledge of its inside for anyone outside: which cell answers a lane is this hive's business and may change without touching a caller.
description.contract_in: Every message whose `hop.route` starts with `in_`. The lanes in use: in_turn (a fresh turn), in_calls (the expectation set of a tool round), in_tool (one tool result), in_answer (the brain's answer), in_bundle (a memory bundle), in_advice (an advisor's answer), in_close (a closed session), in_prune, in_batch, in_round_sweep, in_memory_call. A route that starts with in_ and names no lane the state machine knows is answered by the assembler, not swallowed here.
description.contract_out: Everything the assembler emits that is not an in_ lane and not the internal cstore write, leaving through the hive path: brain (the seam — the caller's edge carries the iteration bound and restore_ttl), recall, answer (told apart by hop.round_capped), write, turn_write, prune. A caller wires the ones it needs and ignores the rest.
